title: Item 20b · Checking in when the Wi-Fi drops
subtitle: Missing — not planned. Rule §3.5 promises: “Check-ins made offline are queued and sent when the connection returns; nothing is discarded.” No section does this — Camps' roster and Prospects' / Calendar's “Came?” need the connection. Item 5b already decided the offline bar (its words stop promising “will sync”). Today a check-in that can't save fails honestly, but nothing is kept on the tablet. Precedent: for grading you chose a printed sheet over an offline queue (v0.188); Camps already has Print roster. (Preview screenshots at PC size · fake data; the preview's date moved into April Vacation Camp week to show Check in)

columns.label: Today

items.caption: 1. Today, when a check-in can't save (tested in the preview): “Ava Thompson wasn't checked in. Check the connection and try again.” with Retry, a “Not saved” tag, and the cell goes back to “Check in”. Nothing is kept on the tablet.

columns.note: Prospects' and Calendar's “Came?” behave the same way. Rule §3.5 still says the check-in would be kept and sent later.

columns.label: Option B (recommended) and option C, drawn

items.caption: 2. Option B — check-ins need the connection: item 5b's offline bar says so on every page; a tap that fails says so with Retry (as today); the paper backup is the camp's ⋯ → Print roster, as the printed grading sheet is for testing (v0.188).
3. Option C — the queue §3.5 promises: a check-in made offline is kept on this tablet (“Not sent yet”) and sent when the connection is back.

columns.note: Pictures 2–3 are drawn over the real camp page; nothing in the app was changed. Prospects' and Calendar's “Came?” would follow the same choice.

footer:
Your choice — one question: what happens to a check-in when the Wi-Fi drops?
A · Keep as today. + no work. − §3.5 promises a queue nobody builds.
B · Recommended: check-ins need the connection (picture 2). §3.5's queue line is dropped; the offline bar (5b), the failed tap's Retry and Print roster cover a Wi-Fi drop — the same choice you made for grading (v0.188). + honest: nothing waits silently on one tablet; no new build. − at a morning drop-off with no Wi-Fi, staff tick the printed roster and type the check-ins in later.
C · Build the queue (picture 3). Check-ins are kept on the tablet and sent later, in Camps and in Prospects / Calendar. + taps never fail at the door. − a real build in two sections and the app's first offline queue: two tablets can disagree, closing the page loses the kept check-ins, and a late send can land after someone else's change.
